messages:
Asha: Dropping a follow-up thread on the autoscale UX. Main tension: show enough info (cost/headroom/burst) without making the card/modal feel dense. Prototype: https://intranet.redwood/protos/autoscale-headroom-v1 :link:

Ben: Quick thought 1: instead of labeling Min/Max as "replicas" everywhere can we use "replica units" in places where fractional/weighted pools exist? UX: show a tiny unit label so numbers don't require extra explanation.

Kara: Accessibility flag: we're leaning heavily on color to show guardrail severity. For colorblind users we must add shape/icon and explicit text (e.g., "Warning: headroom low"). Also add `aria-label` for any icon-only controls.

Maya: On headroom: show a small metric "Headroom: 12%" next to the pool. If headroom < 10% show amber triangle + help link "Why low?" that opens inline doc. Avoid blocking the save but make it visible.

Tom: Burst naming: product asked for "burst budget" instead of "burst capacity". Proposal: show a compact progress chip: "Burst budget 18% used" that opens a popover with remaining minutes and policy. That helps teams understand cost burn.

Asha: UX pattern I mocked: a single-line card row with: pool avatar | name | headroom chip | target (expands) | burst-budget chip | cost delta. Click target expands to min/max and SLO controls. Keeps list compact.

Ben: For SLO controls I'm debating radio-group presets vs a small slider + presets. Radios are explicit and keyboard-friendly; slider is more visual. Maybe do both: radio presets with a mini-slider under them to fine-tune. Presets still show exact diffs when selected.

Kara: If we add both, ensure keyboard nav for the radio group and slider are independent: focus -> radios (left/right arrows) -> Enter applies -> slider tab next for fine-tune (arrow keys change). Announce changes with `role=\"status\" aria-live=\"polite\"`.

Maya: Cost calc perf note: debounce interactive updates to 275ms, cancel inflight. Show a subtle spinner in the cost chip while recalculating. For screen readers the cost chip should be `role=\"status\"` and updated text like: "Estimated cost: $0.42/hr".

Tom: Edge case: if user applies a preset that disables burst but they have a positive burst budget already, surface a small inline advisory: "Preset will disable burst but your burst budget remains. To reclaim budget enable burst or apply refund policy." Tiny link to docs.

Asha: Microcopy change: change modal save button text to "Save autoscale settings" (more explicit). Also add a small inline undo toast when presets make multiple changes. Toast should be keyboard-focusable and have an "Undo" action.

Ben: Telemetry snippet I propose for devs: `track('autoscale.apply_preset', {preset: 'balanced', changes: ['burst:disabled','max:-20'], headroom_before: 0.18, headroom_after: 0.05})`. Debounce telemetry by 500ms so quick toggles are batched.

Kara: A11y extra: for the burst-budget chip use `aria-describedby` to point to the popover content id so screen readers get the remaining time/units when they open it. Also ensure the popover has `role=\"dialog\" aria-modal=\"false\"`.

Maya: I'm going to update the Figma with the burst-budget chip, headroom metric, radio+slider combo, and toast/undo interaction. Will also add colorblind-safe iconography. If no objections I'll push the design PR later today.

Tom: I'll add the cost endpoint changes + the telemetry event to the spec and a note to support burst-budget queries. Will coordinate with infra on debounce + cancel semantics.

Asha: Thanks all 1 If you see anything missing ping here. Otherwise I'll mark this ready for review and tag eng after I push frames. :rocket:
